The local pipeline memo states that variants are filtered when SOR > 4 [fx_sop_sor]. The knowledge graph gives the threshold of procedure HF-01 as SOR > 3.0 for all variant types [G:Threshold:SOR_gt_3] [G:Procedure:HF-01]. The two values differ, and the sources do not state which one applies.
